intro.uz: Nodira ismli talaba chet elda oʻqishning birinchi oylari haqida hikoya qiladi. Oʻqishdan oldin oʻylab koʻring: uydan uzoqda yashashning eng qiyin tomoni nima deb oʻylaysiz?

paragraphs.en: My name is Nodira, and when I received my letter from the university, I was so happy that I cried. I had dreamed about studying abroad since I was fifteen, and now I was going to study computer science in a small university town in England. My parents were proud of me, but my mother was also worried. She asked me who would cook for me. I laughed and told her that I would be fine.

The first weeks were much harder than I had expected. Although I had studied English for years, people spoke very fast, and I often could not understand jokes or local expressions. In lectures, I recorded everything on my phone and listened again in the evening. The food was another problem. Everything seemed to taste the same, and I missed my mother's plov more than I can say. I even tried to cook it myself, but without the right rice it was a disaster.

The hardest part, however, was homesickness. In November, the days became short and grey, and I often sat alone in my room. I called my family every evening, but after each call I felt even lonelier. One day my flatmate, a girl from Brazil, knocked on my door and invited me to a meeting of the international students' club. I did not want to go, but she would not take no for an answer.

That evening changed everything. I met students from more than twenty countries, and many of them were having the same problems as me. We started to cook dinner together every Friday. Each week, someone prepared a dish from their home country. When it was my turn, I made somsa, and everyone asked for the recipe. For the first time, I felt proud to share my culture instead of just missing it.

Now I am in my second year, and I have learned a lot, not only about computers. I have learned that it is normal to feel lost at first and that asking for help is not a weakness. If a friend asked me for advice before going abroad, I would tell them three things: practise listening, not only speaking; learn to cook a few simple dishes; and say yes to invitations, even when you would prefer to stay at home.

glossary.uz: «yoʻq» javobini qabul qilmoq (koʻpincha inkorda: koʻndirmaguncha qoʻymaslik)

title.uz: Past Perfect: had dreamed, had expected

grammar.example: I had dreamed about studying abroad since I was fifteen

title.uz: Ikkinchi shart gap: If a friend asked …, I would tell …

grammar.example: If a friend asked me for advice before going abroad, I would tell them three things

questions.statement: Nodira had wanted to study abroad since she was a teenager.

explain.uz: «I had dreamed about studying abroad since I was fifteen» — 15 yoshidan beri orzu qilgan.

questions.statement: From the start, Nodira found it easy to understand people in England.

explain.uz: Aksincha: «people spoke very fast, and I often could not understand jokes or local expressions».

questions.statement: Nodira's flatmate was also studying computer science.

explain.uz: Kvartiradoshi Braziliyadan ekani aytilgan, lekin u nima oʻqishi haqida maʼlumot yoʻq.

questions.statement: Nodira phoned her family every evening.

explain.uz: «I called my family every evening» — har kuni kechqurun qoʻngʻiroq qilgan.

questions.prompt: Why did Nodira record her lectures?
options: to send them to her family
because she could not always understand fast speech
because her teachers asked her to

explain.uz: 2-xatboshi: odamlar juda tez gapirgan va u ularni har doim ham tushunmagan, shuning uchun «I recorded everything on my phone and listened again in the evening».

questions.prompt: What does «she would not take no for an answer» mean in paragraph 3?
options: She insisted that I should come.
She did not ask me anything.

explain.uz: Nodira borishni xohlamagan, lekin kvartiradoshi «yoʻq» javobini qabul qilmagan — yaʼni qatʼiy turib olgan.
4-xatboshi: Nodira «many of them were having the same problems as me» — oʻzini tushunadigan odamlarni topgan.

questions.prompt: Nodira tried to cook plov, but without the right ___ it was a disaster.

explain.uz: «without the right rice it was a disaster».

questions.prompt: Which piece of advice does Nodira give?
options: Speak as much as possible and do not worry about listening.
Stay at home and focus only on studying.

explain.uz: 5-xatboshi: «practise listening, not only speaking … say yes to invitations».
